diagnostics.message: module.aws_iam_elastic_stack:output.access_key_id: explicit depends_on of module.aws_iam_elastic_stack:resource.aws_iam_access_key.this_user is redundant — already implied by attribute references
module.aws_iam_elastic_stack:output.access_secret_key: explicit depends_on of module.aws_iam_elastic_stack:resource.aws_iam_access_key.this_user is redundant — already implied by attribute references

:resource.helm_release.elk references the secret "elastic-credentials" by name in its values (ELASTIC_PASSWORD / ELASTIC_USERNAME env vars via secretKeyRef), but has no dependency on :resource.kubernetes_secret.elasticsearch_credentials. On a fresh apply the helm release can be installed before the secret exists, causing Elasticsearch pods to fail with CreateContainerConfigError. Add an explicit depends_on for this secret.

:resource.helm_release.elk mounts the secret "elastic-certificates" (secretMounts for TLS certs) referenced by name in its values, but has no dependency on :resource.kubernetes_secret.elasticsearch_certificates. Without ordering, Elasticsearch/Kibana/filebeat pods can start before the TLS certificates secret exists and crash. Add an explicit depends_on for this secret.

:resource.helm_release.elk mounts the secret "elasticsearch-s3-user-creds" into the keystore (S3 snapshot repository credentials) referenced by name in its values, but has no dependency on :resource.kubernetes_secret.elasticsearch_s3_user_creds. On a fresh apply the S3 snapshot user credentials may not be in place when the release is installed, breaking snapshot/keystore setup. Add an explicit depends_on for this secret.

:resource.helm_release.elk references the secret "kibana-encryption-key" via secretKeyRef (KIBANA_ENCRYPTION_KEY) in its kibana values, but has no dependency on :resource.kubernetes_secret.kibana_enc_key. Without ordering, the Kibana pod can start before the secret exists and fail. Add an explicit depends_on for this secret.

module.aws_iam_elastic_stack:output.access_key_id already depends on module.aws_iam_elastic_stack:resource.aws_iam_access_key.this_user through its value attribute (aws_iam_access_key.this_user.id); the explicit depends_on on the same resource is redundant.

module.aws_iam_elastic_stack:output.access_secret_key already depends on module.aws_iam_elastic_stack:resource.aws_iam_access_key.this_user through its value attribute (aws_iam_access_key.this_user.secret); the explicit depends_on on the same resource is redundant.
